file_metadata.scope: Ceremonial Rubrics (General Rules, Vespers, Matins, Liturgy Procedures)
file_metadata.description: Encodes the 'how' of conducting services: door/curtain state changes, censing patterns, vestments, bows, and concelebration logistics. §I nos. 1-28, §II nos. 29-52, §III nos. 53-73, §IV nos. 74-96, §V nos. 97-215.

bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_1: The presiding clergyman alone begins and makes the dismissal of the divine services.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_2: Common introductory prayers: in the name of the priest 'AMEN' (not the priest himself), then O Heavenly King, Trisagion, Our Father.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_3: When 'Glory to Thee, O God' is prescribed, the opening blessing is: 'Blessed is our God.'
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_4: At Vigil opening: 'Glory to the Holy, Consubstantial.'
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_6: Before every prayer the priest says quietly: 'Let us pray to the Lord,' and after: 'Through the prayers of our holy fathers' or the appropriate exclamation.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_7: Great bow = prostration (to the ground). Small bow = inclination of head and shoulders.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_8: Great bows always with sign of cross. Small bows usually without sign of cross except where prescribed.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_9: Never genuflect on Sundays or during Paschal season (Pascha to Pentecost).
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_10: Lenten great bows: 3 after each service termination, with Prayer of St. Ephrem.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_11: Sign of cross at beginning and end of prayers, at 'come let us worship,' at Alleluia, at Holy God.
bows_and_sign_of_cross.no_12: Hands folded at chest when not performing a liturgical action.

sanctuary_and_doors.no_13: Only clergy may enter the sanctuary through the holy doors; servers through side doors only.
sanctuary_and_doors.no_14: The holy doors are never left open unnecessarily.
sanctuary_and_doors.no_15: During readings and litanies the priest stands before the holy table.
sanctuary_and_doors.no_16: Women may never enter the sanctuary.

censing.no_20: Full censing: holy table (4 sides), icons, clergy, choir, people, narthex, return.
censing.no_21: Short censing: holy table front and sides only.
censing.no_22: Censing of holy gifts: 3 swings, thrice (9 total).
censing.no_23: At Presanctified: cense holy gifts 3 times, each with 3 swings.
censing.no_24: Deacon censes; if no deacon, priest censes holding censer in right hand.

vestments.no_26: Vespers with Vigil: epitrachelion and phelonion.
vestments.no_27: Liturgy: full vestments (sticharion, epitrachelion, zone, epimanikia, phelonion).
vestments.no_28: Deacon: sticharion, orarion; at Presanctified communion: orarion crosswise.

sequence.note: Priest reads Vespers prayers at holy table

two_deacons.note: Litanies distributed between deacons; 1st deacon censes, 2nd assists

without_deacon.note: Priest says all litanies himself from before holy table

with_concelebrants.note: Exclamations distributed among concelebrants in order of dignity

additions_over_great_vespers: Psalm 103 with doors open from beginning

artoklasia_sequence.note: Variable: feast x2 + Virgin Theotokos x1, or as specified

sequence.note: 2 or 3 depending on day; Sessional Hymns between
Tone 4 on Sunday; of feast on feast day
Glory: Through intercessions / Both now: Through intercessions of Theotokos
Sung on Sundays, feasts, Polyeleos, Doxology rank

shortened_matins.conditions: When lack of time requires shortening
omissions_permitted: Shorten canon: read only heirmos + last troparion of each ode
Omit sessional hymns after kathismata if needed
never_omit: God is the Lord with troparia

key_rules.no_113: Must cut Lamb at each Liturgy; never use pre-cut or dried Lamb
key_rules.no_114: For larger communion: additional particles placed on diskos

liturgy_sequence_summary: Opening blessing: Blessed is the Kingdom
Litany for Catechumens + Dismissal of Catechumens
Elevation: Holy Things to the Holy

communion_rules.no_141: Priest communicates of Body first, then Blood
communion_rules.no_142: Deacon receives particle from priest, then Blood from chalice
communion_rules.no_143: Faithful receive by intinction (Body dipped in Blood by spoon)
communion_rules.no_144: Formula: 'The precious and most holy Body and Blood of our Lord'

key_rules.no_175: All rites of solemn Liturgy preserved; exclamations must be audible
key_rules.no_177: Censer use not absolutely required but praiseworthy
key_rules.no_178: Never omit prayer 'O Lord, stretch forth Thy hand'
key_rules.no_179: Proskomedia on side altar, not sacristy; may use one prosphora

key_rules.no_186: Actual concelebrants exclaim words of consecration; non-actual do not
key_rules.no_188: Actual concelebrants recite ALL priestly prayers; assistants only exclamations in turn
key_rules.no_193: Reserved exclamations for principal celebrant listed
key_rules.no_201: All concelebrants point and sing words of consecration simultaneously

positioning.at_holy_table: 1st to right, 2nd to left, 3rd to right, etc.

key_rules.no_210: Litanies distributed among concelebrants; 2 priests alternate, 3 priests rotate per scheme
key_rules.no_213: Not all need go out for Great Entrance
